review_method: All 305 original/native pairs and 25 tail frames were inspected in the prior complete pass. This focused correction re-inspected every one of 36 changed native pairs and eight enclosing boundary pairs in six native-pixel delta sheets. All 330 final states were freshly rasterized; 294 other native/tail frames match the prior reviewed RGBA exactly. The change is confined to badge contour/halo pixels.
remaining_differences: The source font is unknown. Licensed Liberation Sans is optically fitted but fine glyph contours and rasterization differ.
The independent pot, parcel, bicycle, hand and paw paths retain small curve and glow differences.
Procedurally authored paper grain has different microstructure from the original.
Scalar edge/color/opacity measurements contain video compression and threshold uncertainty; they are not recovered CSS.
All observed motion is retained, with a 25-frame authored re-arm tail. Actual browser runtime remains untested.
